id: title:CShine612:gate runs on the run list and scope run failures

observations.behavior: Adds a runtime reason to account for pending job checks before marking UI as busy.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies UX state while the warehouse connector waits for an async result; prevents premature disabling of controls.

observations.behavior: Changes failure handler from no-arg reset to conditional clearing based on current view ID. This preserves state across unrelated views and avoids false-positive resets when other saved queries fail.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces risk of losing legitimate pending status in multi-view dashboards by correctly scoping failures to their originating context.

observations.code_quote: const runStateReason = !dataModelingJobs && !dataModelingJobsError ? 'Checking for a running refresh' : undefined
observations.behavior: Replaces removed comment with computed message indicating that actions are disabled because jobs have not yet arrived rather than due to error or deletion.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer user feedback during transient loading windows between query submission and first poll response.

observations.limitations: All changes are confined to frontend TypeScript and React components without backend implementation or shared API contract updates. No tests demonstrate end-to-end behavior or recovery paths under production-like conditions. The tier relies solely on test assertions and comments rather than live execution evidence.

review.limitations: All changes are confined to frontend TypeScript and React components without backend implementation or shared API contract updates. No tests demonstrate end-to-end behavior or recovery paths under production-like conditions. The tier relies solely on test assertions and comments rather than live execution evidence.
review.reason: The patch demonstrates bounded correctness improvements: it fixes potential race-condition handling around warehouse job polling and clarifies UI busy states while preserving cross-view isolation. These are substantive, localized reliability and UX enhancements whose implementation is visible; however, the absence of broader systemic safeguards, shared dependency changes, or comprehensive validation prevents this from reaching tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: These hunks improve warehouse materialization workflow stability and reduce false-positive control disabling, benefiting warehouse-connected users who rely on accurate status indicators and uninterrupted action availability despite async delays.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends entirely on provided diff chunk; no access to runtime behavior, complete repository context, or deployment history.
